**Details**

- **Status:** In demo (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Agent 360° profiles** — each of the fixed agents (seven since PR 581; five blog authors since PR 593) (প্রহরী Prohori, ভান্ডারী Bhandari, সওদাগর Sawdagor, শিল্পী Shilpi, দূত Doot, জ্ঞানী Gyani — renamed by the owner 19 Oct) has an employee-style profile in the AI 360 Control Room: role and owned stages, what it never touches, its plan, skills it has and skills it is learning (linked to the Skill Library, PR 321–323), work log (every task, PR, file), test results (device gate, QA checklist runs), performance (first-time-right rate, bugs found by the owner vs by itself, cost). The same agents (seven since PR 581) build the code and then run the live dashboard sections — no new agents, no re-teaching. **The owner edits each profile:** photo, name, bio, joining date, rewards, a verified ✓ star, and assignments with due dates. **Memory protocol** (agents/AGENT-PROTOCOL.md): before every task the agent loads its profile, standards, owned skills and recent work log and restates its duties; after every task the runner appends the work log automatically and any new lesson becomes a versioned skill (sandbox-tested, PR 322; approval-gated, PR 420); the library is in the nightly Google Drive backup.

**বাংলায়:** শিগগির — এখনো বানানো হয়নি। “AI কন্ট্রোল রুম” ধাপের অংশ: সব AI এজেন্টের সুইচ, খরচের সীমা, অনুমতি আর রিপোর্ট এক জায়গায়।

**Details**

- **Status:** In demo (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Model auto-suggest with free-model qualification** — for every agent job the system suggests a model with its reason; the owner accepts or changes it. Free models are in the pool and are **qualified**: each job type has a quality test set, every candidate (paid or free) is scored, and the cheapest model that passes the job's quality bar is suggested — cost falls only when quality holds, never by lowering it. Shows quality per candidate, cost per 100 runs, monthly saving, last test date, "re-test now". Works with the spend caps (PR 309) and the cost book (PR 312–313).

## PR 583

**Chief agent — জ্ঞানী Gyani as virtual CEO (প্রধান এজেন্ট), chain of command**

**বাংলায়:** শিগগির — এখনো বানানো হয়নি। “AI কন্ট্রোল রুম” ধাপের অংশ: সব AI এজেন্টের সুইচ, খরচের সীমা, অনুমতি আর রিপোর্ট এক জায়গায়।

**Details**

- **Status:** In demo (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Chief agent — জ্ঞানী Gyani as virtual CEO (প্রধান এজেন্ট), chain of command.** The owner charges one agent; Gyani answers to him and charges the other six by their performance. Asked "why are sales down this month / this week?", "why was today's courier entry wrong?", "why is this bug on the category page?", Gyani investigates across every section (orders, ads, stock, delivery, site errors, the agents' work logs), names **which agent's area caused it, with evidence**, assigns the fix to that agent, tracks it to done and reports back. Broad knowledge beyond its own stages (business, finance, operations, marketing, tech) — curriculum adds an executive/general-management track. Second only to the owner. **Free to do:** research, reports, analysis, assigning and reviewing work, warnings to agents (written into their appraisals PR 578). **Only with the owner's approval:** any money movement or refund, any COD amount change on an order, price or discount changes, ad budget increases, blocking anyone, deleting data, anything that cannot be undone. The permission list is a dashboard setting the owner edits; enforced by code. Lives in S15 AI 360 (org chart, open investigations, who-owns-what).

## PR 584

**Telegram identity and command routing**

**বাংলায়:** শিগগির — এখনো বানানো হয়নি। “AI কন্ট্রোল রুম” ধাপের অংশ: সব AI এজেন্টের সুইচ, খরচের সীমা, অনুমতি আর রিপোর্ট এক জায়গায়।

**Details**

- **Status:** In demo (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Telegram identity and command routing.** All agents share the owner's one Telegram bot. Every message starts with the sender's identity — photo/emoji, name, Bengali name, **employee code**, role (e.g. "🏹 Tirondaj তীরন্দাজ · A360-07 · Ads") — so the owner always knows who sent it. When the owner writes a command naming an agent or its code ("A360-07 budget report", "@Bhandari courier entry check"), the task is **assigned to that agent automatically**, appears on its profile as an assignment, and the agent replies in the same thread when done. No name → goes to the chief (Gyani), who routes it. Approvals come back as buttons (Approve / Reject / Ask why). Also visible in the dashboard.

## PR 585

**Continuous learning engine — Tirondaj (ads) and Doot (SEO/marketing) are the two power agents**

**বাংলায়:** শিগগির — এখনো বানানো হয়নি। “AI কন্ট্রোল রুম” ধাপের অংশ: সব AI এজেন্টের সুইচ, খরচের সীমা, অনুমতি আর রিপোর্ট এক জায়গায়।

**Details**

- **Status:** Filed (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Continuous learning engine — Tirondaj (ads) and Doot (SEO/marketing) are the two power agents.** They learn without stopping from: official docs (Meta, Google, TikTok, Search Central), the big practitioner blogs on SEO and paid ads, Reddit communities (PPC, Facebook ads, SEO, e-commerce), YouTube tutorials incl. South-Asian e-commerce channels (read through transcripts), LinkedIn and Facebook posts of known specialists (where readable; through a paid tool if needed), case studies. **When stuck:** research all sources → solve → the solution becomes a skill in its basket. **Quality gate (no shortcut learning):** a tip becomes a skill only after it is checked against the official docs or two independent good sources, tested in a sandbox or small live test, and written with its source, date and confidence; tips that fail are recorded as "doesn't work for us". **Practice tasks with deadlines** (e.g. get a new page indexed within 3 days, a long-tail keyword into Google's top 10, a test campaign under the CPA cap) graded in their appraisals. **Paid data tools** (e.g. an SEO suite) proposed with cost and reason — the owner approves and pays.
- **Filed under:** [S15 · AI 360 Control Room — PR 304–341](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s15--ai-360-control-room--pr-304341)
